title: GaitVista: Reliability-Aware AI Measurement toward Accessible Longitudinal Gait Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2609.22619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tracking recovery of walking function requires detecting meaningful gait change across rehabilitation sessions, yet objective 3D measurement remains confined to specialized motion-capture laboratories. Small camera sets and body-worn inertial sensors broaden access, but reliability varies across joints and time, allowing sensing failures to masquerade as patient change. We present \textsc{GaitVista}, a reliability-aware measurement layer whose lightweight gate assigns joint- and frame-specific visual contributions using camera coverage, local visual quality, cross-modal disagreement, and root-motion continuity, and exposes them for inspection. Across seven clean and degraded sensing conditions on TotalCapture, \textsc{GaitVista} reduces average full-body and lower-body error by \textbf{27.7\%} and \textbf{27.8\%}, attains the lowest worst-condition error among fusion methods, and reduces the gap to a joint-frame oracle from $2.76$--$5.33

translated_title: GaitVista：面向可及的纵向步态评估的可靠性感知AI测量
translated_abstract: 追踪步行功能的恢复需要在多个康复疗程之间检测有意义的步态变化，然而客观的3D测量目前仍局限于专业的动作捕捉实验室。小型相机组合和身体佩戴的惯性传感器扩大了测量的可及性，但其可靠性在不同关节和不同时间上存在差异，导致传感故障可能被误认为是患者的真实变化。我们提出了GaitVista，一个可靠性感知的测量层，其轻量级门控机制利用相机覆盖范围、局部视觉质量、跨模态不一致性和根运动连续性，为每个关节和每一帧分配特定的视觉贡献权重，并将这些权重公开以供检查。在TotalCapture数据集的七种干净和退化传感条件下，GaitVista将平均全身误差和下肢误差分别降低了27.7%和27.8%，在融合方法中取得了最低的最差条件误差，并将与关节-帧oracle之间的差距从2.76–5.33（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: GaitVista提出了一种可靠性感知的AI测量层，通过轻量级门控机制为每个关节和帧动态分配视觉贡献权重，在多种干净与退化传感条件下将全身和下肢步态测量误差降低约27.8%，使纵向步态评估摆脱对专业动作捕捉实验室的依赖。
en_tdlr: GaitVista introduces a reliability-aware measurement layer whose lightweight gate assigns joint- and frame-specific visual contributions, reducing full-body and lower-body gait measurement errors by about 27.8% across clean and degraded sensing conditions, enabling accessible longitudinal gait assessment beyond specialized motion-capture laboratories.
